findings.title: Hidden Python paths can bypass the independent diff coverage threshold

summary: Independent review reproduced a hidden-path diff coverage bypass in candidate 48efbf6 despite 2883 passing tests and all native checks. A new analysis/.unexecuted.py with four unexecuted lines appears at zero coverage in XML while analysis total coverage remains 96 percent; the additional include glob omits that hidden path, so diff-cover reports no measurable lines and the checker exits zero. Remove the redundant include filter because domain XML is already isolated, and add both-domain hidden file and hidden directory regressions.
